facts.description: Grand Dunman is a 99-year leasehold New Launch condominium along Dunman Road, near to Dakota MRT presented by SingHaiYi Group.
facts.keyPoints:
💫First MEGA Project in D15 that’s 1-min walk to MRT (Dakota CCL)
💫7-min drive to MBS/CBD 
💫Rare Luxury Waterfront Living 
💫Doorstep to Park Connector with direct access to Marina Bay Waterfront 
💫Within 1KM to Popular Schools like Kong Hwa Pri & Tanjong Katong Pri 
💫1:1 carpark 
💫Breathtaking views from many units
